key_evidence_spans: A 63-year-old woman with a history of left breast cancer
Abdominal ultrasonography showed a complex cystic mass in the pancreatic head measuring 5.5 × 4.5 cm with internal calcifications and mural nodularity

Contrast-enhanced computed tomography revealed a 65 × 63 × 55 mm cystic lesion in the uncinate process with a smooth-walled capsule containing calcifications, enhancing septa, millimetric nodules, and soft-tissue components
without distant metastases or intraabdominal lymphadenopathy
Her anesthetic evaluation classified her as ASA-2, and an exploratory laparotomy was scheduled
